title: Lindsay Hubbard Teases a Bigger Second Season of In the City
excerpt:
The Summer House spinoff is filming its next chapter.
Hubbard also discusses motherhood and a child-hunger initiative.
body_md:
Lindsay Hubbard says the second season of In the City could surpass the first as the Summer House spinoff continues production. Although she is optimistic about what the new episodes will deliver, she has not confirmed the final cast or detailed the biggest storylines. Fans will need to wait for an official announcement before treating rumored lineup changes as settled.

Hubbard is balancing the reality series with life as a mother to her daughter Gemma. She has also partnered with the No Kid Hungry Amplify Impact campaign, joining a New York food event that offered breakfast to local residents. The initiative aims to expand access to meals for millions of children over the coming years.

The reality star also addressed public speculation about her relationship with fellow television personality Kyle Cooke, rejecting the suggestion that their friendship should be read as a confirmed romance. Her remarks illustrate the mix of personal scrutiny and on-screen drama that surrounds the franchise. Season 2 is in development, but a precise premiere date has not been confirmed.
